current_architecture: Scope Model × Feature Model → Page Composition
purpose: Machine-readable boundary contract for interpreting knowledge-asset scope metadata while historical LOC1–8 references remain in stable records.
rules: LOC1–8 values in legacy related_scopes, IDs, titles, paths or notes are historical/provenance references only.
A historical LOC reference must never create Current Scope, Feature ownership, NAV taxonomy, Registry authority or Canon authority.
Current consumers must use explicit current Scope/authority metadata where present and use domain/content_type/Feature metadata for capability routing.
Consumers must not infer a new Current Scope by mechanically mapping LOC1–8 to Music, Writing, Media, Governance, Analysis or Evolution.
When a legacy related_scopes array contains LOC1–8 values, Current projections must omit those values from Scope filtering while preserving the source record unchanged for provenance.
Historical questions about LOC1–8 may still retrieve the source record, but the answer/view must identify the reference as historical rather than Current ownership.

current_projection.related_scopes_behavior: filter legacy LOC1–8 values from Current Scope filtering
current_projection.primary_scope_behavior: ignore numbered LOC values as Current Scope if encountered

migration_target.rule: Future source-level migration may move numbered values to historical_loc_refs only when stable IDs and provenance remain unchanged.
